summary: Lane bully who wants to stack Hemorrhage and snowball off one won extended fight. He has no real gap closer besides E pull, so kiting and disengage beat him; standing still in melee range loses.
threats: Outer edge of Q (Decimate) deals bonus damage and heals him: never stand on the blade's ring.
E (Apprehend) pull defines his threat range. When it's on cooldown he is very vulnerable.
5 stacks of Hemorrhage give Noxian Might. Don't extend a fight once he has 3+ stacks on you.
R (Noxian Guillotine) at level 5 executes and resets on kill, so low-HP fights become lethal.

matchups.why: Teemo's range and Blinding Dart cut Darius's damage at the source: a blinded Darius misses autos, so he can't stack Hemorrhage or land W. Move Quick lets you walk out of E range, and he has no other way to reach you.
trading: Auto + Toxic Shot when he walks up to last-hit, then step back out of E range.
Save Q (Blinding Dart) for when he commits; blind him the moment he starts auto-ing or casts W.
When he casts Q, walk fully out of the blade or inside it. Never stay on the outer ring.
If he lands E, blind immediately and Move Quick away. Don't trade back.
matchups.early: Level 1 is your window: he can't reach you without burning E. Poke freely and make him choose between creeps and HP.
matchups.spike: At 5, place mushrooms (R) in river and tri-brush to stop ganks and slow his approach. Respect his R: if you're under ~40% and he has 4+ stacks, back off.
matchups.wave: Keep the wave slightly on your side so he must walk through your poke to farm, and your jungler can collapse on him.
matchups.jungle: Darius has no escape once E is down. Ping your jungler when he wastes E on a wave or misses it on you.
matchups.build: Electrocute for kill pressure or Phase Rush for safety. Get boots early to kite; build armor if he gets ahead.
matchups.remember: Blind the W, dodge the ring, stay out of E range.

matchups.why: Cannon-form Jayce can poke Darius out of lane before Darius ever reaches him. Hammer E (Thundering Blow) knocks him away mid-combo, buying time to swap back to range and kite.
trading: Cannon Q (boosted through Acceleration Gate when mana allows) when he steps forward for creeps.
If he walks at you: Hammer E to knock him back, swap to cannon, and walk away.
Only use Hammer Q in when his E is on cooldown, then get out before he stacks you.
Never take an extended hand-to-hand trade; Jayce wins on burst, not sustain.
matchups.early: Lv 1–3: cannon autos plus Q poke. Keep him low so he can't contest the wave without risking a fight at low HP.
matchups.spike: Your power doesn't spike at 5 like his does. Darius's R gives him a real kill threat, so get your poke done early and play farther back once he's level 5.
matchups.wave: If you've poked him down, freeze near your tower so he has to walk through Cannon Q range to farm.
matchups.jungle: Call your jungler when he's below half. Hammer E can knock him straight into your jungler.
matchups.build: Electrocute or Phase Rush. Lethality items; buy armor boots early if he's snowballing.
matchups.remember: Knock him off you with Hammer E, never brawl.

matchups.why: Malphite's armor and passive shield blunt Darius's early trades, and Q steals his move speed so he can't chase. But Darius's damage stays high with armor pen and bleed, so you won't kill him; you just won't lose.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) when he walks up, then walk away with the stolen speed.
E (Ground Slam) once he's auto-ing you; slower attacks mean fewer Hemorrhage stacks.
Keep Granite Shield up. Don't take minion aggro that pops it right before a trade.
Never stand in melee range while his Q is off cooldown.
matchups.early: Farm safely and Q poke. You won't win a level 1–3 all-in, so aim for a quiet lane.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives kill threat with a jungler and an escape. With armor, you can survive his R.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower. Darius struggles to dive Malphite.
matchups.jungle: Your R is great gank setup. Ping your jungler when R is up and he's pushed past the middle of the lane.
matchups.build: Grasp of the Undying. Early armor plus anti-heal (Bramble Vest into Thornmail) cuts his Q healing.
matchups.remember: Shield up, slow his attacks with E, Q and walk away.

matchups.why: Garen's Q silence stops Darius casting E or Q mid-trade, and W gives tenacity against his slow and pull. Darius still wins long fights at full stacks, so trade short and let your passive regen between trades.
trading: Q right after he uses E, or as he walks forward, so he can't answer with spells.
Don't spin (E) through a full fight. He'll reach 5 stacks and out-sustain you with Q heals.
Disengage after each short trade to let Perseverance regen. He has no sustain besides Q.
When he winds up Q, walk into him (inside the blade) to deny the heal.
matchups.early: Levels 1–2 are even. Short Q-silence trades only; walk away before his Hemorrhage reaches 3 stacks.
matchups.spike: Both ults execute at 5. Track his HP and be the one to land the first execute.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take short trades when he steps up. Freeze if he gets ahead.
matchups.jungle: He's gankable after he uses E. Your Q gives your jungler the silence window.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor boots and an anti-heal item if he snowballs.
matchups.remember: Silence him before he combos, and never sit at 5 stacks.

matchups.why: Darius denies Nasus's farming: every Q stack you go for puts you in his E and auto range. He out-damages you heavily before level 5 and can zone you off the wave entirely.
trading: Don't trade. Last-hit with Q only when his E is on cooldown.
If he engages, W (Wither) him to cut his attack and move speed, then walk away.
If he gets 3+ stacks on you, disengage immediately.
matchups.early: Give up some creeps. Your goal is surviving to level 5 with a reasonable Q stack count.
matchups.spike: R gives you extra HP and resists, but still avoid 1v1s until you have items and stacks.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm with Q under tower. Never overextend.
matchups.jungle: Ask for an early gank: he has to push to pressure you. Call it when his E is down.
matchups.build: Grasp or Phase Rush. Armor boots early; Bramble Vest for anti-heal.
matchups.remember: Survive and stack. You win the 25-minute game, not the 3-minute one.
